gates.name: site check
gates.reason: The aggregate `npm --prefix site run check` chains test:browser, which asserts toMatchScreenshot against a committed baseline corpus containing only -chromium-linux and -chromium-win32 references (no -chromium-darwin). On this macOS machine every one of those 16 assertions has no reference image, so the matcher writes a new image and fails by contract — this is design/90-decisions.md's 2026-08-08 entry "Known-and-retained gap: the W65.5 visual-baseline gate cannot run on macOS", not a regression. Per that decision, ran the six non-browser sub-gates individually instead: format:check (prettier --check, clean), lint (oxlint, one pre-existing warning in PlayApp.tsx:173 unrelated to this branch, exit 0), typecheck (tsc -b, clean), test (vitest run, 4 files / 44 tests passed), test:build (build + verify-build.mjs, passed), test:merge (verify-merge.mjs, passed). The generated -chromium-darwin PNGs were deleted rather than left staged. CI runs the full aggregate on Linux against the committed -chromium-linux baselines, so that is where this gate's real verdict comes from for this PR.
